comments.text: Logic: the cleanup reference uses the wrong alias. It should be "idp-alias-" + i rather than "alias". Suggested change: use identityProviders().get("idp-alias-" + i)::remove in the addCleanup call.
Logic: same cleanup problem with the incorrect alias reference. Suggested change: use identityProviders().get("idp-alias-20")::remove in the addCleanup call.
Logic: calling session.identityProviders().getById(id) invokes the same provider recursively, which could cause inconsistent caching behavior. Suggested change: call idpDelegate.getById(id) instead.
